missing-permission: You do not have permission to control the server configurations.
Config.Description.Rendering: Local rendering distance, limits, and visual adjustments.
Config.Description.Lores: Local footprint settings for lore creatures.
Config.Description.PartialControlled: Configurations that can optionally be broadcasted to clients.
Config.Hint.BroadcastServerConfigs: Enable to share the following configs with all players. (requires player to rejoin)
Config.Hint.DebugLogging: Logs debug info to the console.
Config.Hint.AcceptServerConfig: Allow the server to override your local configs (e.g. surface materials whitelist). Disable to keep your own.
Config.Hint.FootprintOpacity: Adjusts how dark or transparent the footprints are. (Higher values make them more opaque)
Config.Hint.LowResolution: Use low-resolution texture for slightly better perf.
Config.Hint.RenderDistance: Maximum distance at which footprints are visible.
Config.Hint.MaxFootprints: Maximum number of footprints stored in memory.
Config.Hint.MaxVisibleFootprints: Maximum number of footprints rendered at once.
Config.Hint.MinimalDistance: Minimal distance between footprints texture.(Increase to prevent overlap & improve perf)
Config.Hint.RequireSneaking: Footprints are only visible when the player is sneaking.
Config.Hint.SneakFadeInSpeed: The time (in seconds) it takes for footprints to fully appear when you start sneaking.
Config.Hint.SneakFadeOutSpeed: The time (in seconds) it takes for footprints to fully disappear when you stop sneaking.
Config.Hint.ToggleWhenSneaking: Enable footprint creation when the player is sneaking.
Config.Hint.CustomPlayerPrints: Enable to use ./custom.png for player footprints. (Requires restart)
Config.Hint.CustomPlayerTextureHeight: Height of the custom footprint texture.
Config.Hint.CustomPlayerTextureWidth: Width of the custom footprint texture.
Config.Hint.ToggleLoreMonster: Show footprints for lore related creatures.
Config.Hint.ToggleDomesticated: Show footprints for domesticated animals. (Gen > 0) (Need restart)
Config.Hint.BabySize: Show smaller footprints for baby animals. (x0.75) | False => normal size
Config.Hint.MinimalStepDistance: Base distance between footprints; `stepDistance` attribute from the entity behavior is added + some randomness
Config.Hint.SurfaceMaterials: List of valid surface materials (block code) for prints. [Use StartsWith, No RegEx]
Config.Hint.ToggleAnimalsWhitelist: Enable to filter by the list below. (May take time to apply)
Config.Hint.AnimalsWhitelist: List of valid animals (entity code) for prints. [Use StartsWith, No RegEx]
